name: Session VWAP reclaim and reject
idea: Within one session, a signal when the close moves back above the session VWAP after trading below it (bullish), or back below it after trading above it (bearish), optionally only with the higher-timeframe trend.

params.label: Trend filter
params.help: Only signal when the close on the higher timeframe is on the same side of its trend average.

params.label: Trend timeframe
params.help: The higher timeframe the trend filter reads (closed bars only).

params.label: Trend average type
params.help: How the trend average is calculated.

params.label: The idea is wrong beyond
params.help: The session's extreme since the market crossed to the other side of VWAP, or VWAP with a buffer.
choice_labels: The session extreme since the cross

params.label: Buffer ATR period
params.help: For 'VWAP with a buffer': the bars of the average true range the buffer is measured in.

params.label: VWAP buffer
params.help: For 'VWAP with a buffer': how many average true ranges beyond VWAP.

constraints.message: The trend timeframe must be higher than the signal timeframe.
